import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0179 (A B : Set α) : 
  card (A Δ B) = card (A Δ (A ∩ B)) + card ((A ∩ B) Δ (A ∪ B)) + card (A ∪ B Δ A ∪ B) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0179 (A B : Set α) : 
  card (A Δ B) = card (A Δ (A ∩ B)) + card ((A ∩ B) Δ (A ∪ B)) + card (A ∪ B Δ A ∪ B) := by
  simp only [card_symmdiff, symmdiff_eq, card_empty, card_eq_zero, union_eq_self, inter_eq_self, diff_empty, diff_self]
  ring
end Nl2LeanCandidate
